name: jelly-radio
title: Jelly Radio
description: A single-choice row of rounded chips where the selected one grows, turns light and pushes the others outward with a springy wobble. Arrow keys move the choice.
use: A small, fixed set of options needs a single choice with a tactile, attention-drawing highlight.
avoid: The swelling and pushing need horizontal room; many options or long labels overflow narrow screens.
a11y: Radio roles and arrow-key control are solid, but the focused chip shows no visible focus ring, only the selected fill. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A horizontal row of rounded dark-grey pill chips with white labels, one lit to a solid white fill with dark text and standing slightly taller and wider. The neighbours sit evenly spaced on a near-black stage, with a small prompt above and a large value below.
behaves: Clicking a chip springs the highlight to it: the chosen pill swells, flips to white and pushes the pills on either side outward while they shrink slightly. The group settles with a light jelly wobble, and arrow keys move the selection.
customise: Items, value/defaultValue, onChange, chip and active colours, text colours, size, gap, radius, swell, barge, shrink, jelly, bounce, stagger, stiffness and disabled are props.
weight: light: Only a handful of chips with spring transforms; it idles once settled.
